insights.title: Elementary standard derivatives,nesting and real domains
insights.teaching_comparison: Goldie motivates naturalderivatives throughln/expinverse relationships and trigderivatives throughgradientgraphs,then gives standard/composite drills. YM first introduces algebraic product/quotientrules,then e,lnandtrigfunctions,explicitly separating sums,products and quotients. Both show alternative loglaw routes,but a positive-only expansion cannotreplace a chain route on a larger originaldomain. Standard radiansine/cos/tan are prescribed;reciprocaltrig derivative proofs use those premises rather than invent mandatoryrecall.
insights.examination_comparison: NSSCAS2024P2Q4(a)and2025P2Q10(a)anchor standard/composite elementarycalculus. A graphical gradient-investigation asks visualevidence beyond an algebraic derivative;an optionalfirst-principles derivation is teaching support rather than required examinationproof. A derivative formula request doesnotdirectlyassess a stationarypoint that an author could subsequently find.
insights.difficulty_and_grade_bounds: E13names elementary standard/composite derivatives;C13/A14retain them with product/quotient and implicit/parametric extensions. Harder nesting changes chain/domain reasoning:√xversus√(e^x),ln(x²)versus(lnx)²,and powers ofsinxversussin(kx). Numericalcoefficient size alone is not a levelboundary.
insights.pitfalls: Goldie9andYM14have a valid derivative but a loglawworking route losing negativex. YM16(d)prints a wrongnumerator coefficient. Degreecoordinates require theangularunitfactor. These are source/author cautions,not examiner-frequency evidence or justification to classify a standard derivative by the sophistication of its modelsolution.
insights.gaps_and_representations: Both books provide rich symboliccalculus;Goldie’s derivativegraph frame adds a representation not equivalent to formula-only practice. Optionalproofs and reciprocal-function derivations remain labelledsupport. Originalholes and finite-derivative endpoints remain even when a simplifiedanswer looks defined elsewhere.
insights.implications_for_step3: Propose storing original expression/domain and requested derivativeform,testing equivalentanswers only on that domain,and retaining requiredvisual/proof evidence where asked. Keep nested-domain branches and explicitlyderived reciprocalfunctions separate from mandatoryrecall. Sourceproofexposition should not expand8227scope.

insights.title: Product/quotient selection,prescribed methods and valid alternatives
insights.teaching_comparison: Goldie opens with product/quotient derivations and examples explicitly demanding those methods,then permits alternate productrewrite in laterexamples. YM shows expansion as a valid alternative for its opening polynomialproduct before adding affinepowers,radicals and elementaryfunctions. The same printed expression can have different assessed method evidence when one source enforces a rule and another permits any valid method.
insights.examination_comparison: NSSCAS2021P2Q5(a),2022P2Q5(a),2023P2Q5(a)and2024P2Q1anchor product/quotientcalculus. Those examination awards must be read individually;a methodprescription in a textbook doesnotestablish an identical official awardtable. Explicitcurve product/quotient derivatives doNOTbecome implicit/parametricgeometric demandM2T4O03D03.
insights.difficulty_and_grade_bounds: C13/A14explicitly include products and quotients. Difficulty grows through innerchainfactors,radicaldomains,secondorder or geometrylater;presence of a fraction alone is insufficient. Rationalpowers/simplifiedsums inMaths1remain validlower scaffolds without requiringMaths2rules.
insights.pitfalls: YMTry8(c)’sWHOLEsqrtquotient has a validnegative-domaincomponent lost by splittingits key radicals. An equivalent quotient/productrewrite must retainoriginalpoles;correctincidence or one sampleinput doesnotcertify the derivative. Quotientorder and missingproductterm are mathematical feedback hypotheses here,not an asserted examinererrorrate.
insights.gaps_and_representations: Both books offer direct drill breadth and applications. Goldie supplies explicitlyprescribed methodbranches;YM provides free-method expansion/rewrite contrasts. A derivative used to find a pointgradient or stationarycoordinate is a component unless the formula/method is independently asked. Sourcepartlinking must preserve that distinction.
insights.implications_for_step3: Propose per-partmethodrequirements,accepting equivalentvalid routes when unconstrained,and original-domain equivalence checks. Retain a required method comparison as extraevidence;do not count productrule versus expansion as separate recipes automatically. Guard explicit-versus-implicit/parametric classification independently of algebraform.
